evidence.observation: Menu card reads 'First steps. Real jumps.' with ENTER / START; ENTER starts the run at t=2.0.
evidence.riff: The whole game is taught in one card — no tutorial walls; the tuition for skipping it is one half-second retry.

evidence.observation: Controls row on the menu: A/D or arrows move, Space jumps, R retries, Esc pauses.
evidence.riff: One jump, four bindings, zero combos — the control scheme fits on a single line.

evidence.observation: Player runs right and jumps the first step; single jump only, no double jump.
evidence.riff: The 53px max jump is the level's whole difficulty budget — every obstacle is a variation on one leap.

evidence.observation: Tutorial yard: coin arcs, step, first spike bed, two gaps — geometry unchanged from the original 960px level.
evidence.riff: Keeping the yard intact makes the extension readable: old ground, new tricks.

evidence.observation: Coins collected along the route; HUD counter climbs 00/23 upward with each pickup.
evidence.riff: Coins are the film's progress bar — the counter tells you the run's story at a glance.

evidence.observation: Three question blocks bonked at t=7.88/8.52/9.13; each pops a coin and flips to the spent sprite.
evidence.riff: Bonking is the Mario verb this level is built around — the sign even says 'Jump into them. Trust me.'

evidence.observation: Head-sweep bonk: jumping into the block pays a coin with a '+1' tick; used block turns gray.
evidence.riff: The detection is generous — near misses still pay out, which feels good rather than fussy.

evidence.observation: Gap at x448-512 jumped cleanly; two more gaps cleared later in the run.
evidence.riff: Gaps are the honest jump — no enemy, no trick, just distance versus the 53px budget.

evidence.observation: Two green pipes hopped: onto pipe1, across to pipe2, spikes between them.
evidence.riff: Pipes turn jumping into routing — the obstacle is the line you choose, not the leap.

evidence.observation: Staircase climbed to the high platform; the route takes a vertical jump to clear the stair wedge.
evidence.riff: Stairs are jumps with commitment issues — each step is a small promise you keep mid-air.

evidence.observation: Grumbler patrols x1620-1700 at 55px/s; this run leaps over it from the platform edge.
evidence.riff: The patrol is a moving question: jump over for safety, stomp for greed — same enemy, two risk profiles.

evidence.observation: Player lands on the grumbler while falling; the enemy dies and vanishes, player bounces on.
evidence.riff: The stomp window is brutally tight — falling fast onto a 55px/s target — which is why it gets its own take.

evidence.observation: The 64-pixel spike bed cleared with one committed jump; no room for a correction hop.
evidence.riff: The level's exam question: 64px at this jump's range means you decide before you leap.

evidence.observation: FINISH flag touched at x1881; 'Course complete.' card with ENTER / PLAY AGAIN.
evidence.riff: The flag is a period, not an exclamation mark — the run just ends, cleanly.

evidence.observation: Completion stats: '13.2 seconds / 0 retries / 22 coins - Solid haul.'
evidence.riff: The rank grades the run, not the player — and note 'Coin master' can never fire; it's a dead branch.

evidence.observation: HUD: title, COINS x/23, progress bar, RETRIES, timer, controls reminder, 'No lives. Just another try.'
evidence.riff: The HUD never hides information the player needs — the design trusts the player to read.

evidence.observation: Death card: 'Watch the spikes / Back at the start in a moment.' RETRIES ticks to 01.
evidence.riff: The card teaches instead of punishing — it names what killed you.

evidence.observation: Auto-retry 0.55s after death; player respawns at spawn with no input and runs on.
evidence.riff: No lives, no game-over screen — the loop is die, learn, retry in under a second.

evidence.observation: Pause card lists 'R: restart attempt' and 'M: main menu' bindings.
evidence.riff: The bindings sit on the pause card like a fire exit sign — there when you need them.

evidence.observation: R pressed mid-run: instant restart_attempt, player back at spawn with no death.
evidence.riff: R is the speedrunner's button — the run restarts before regret can form.

evidence.observation: ESC pauses, then M returns to the menu card; coins reset to 00/23, retries persist.
evidence.riff: M is the graceful exit — back to the menu with your retry count intact.

evidence.observation: ESC freezes mid-run: 'Take a breath.' card with ENTER / RESUME; second ESC resumes exactly in place.
evidence.riff: A hard freeze — trivially correct, zero drama, the sim just stops.

evidence.observation: Five jumps at the hidden block's exact spot; eblock.found stays false — the block is real but unreachable (84px climb needed, 53px max jump).
evidence.riff: An honest negative: the footage documents a genuine defect, not a secret. The Verdict covers it.

evidence.observation: Player runs off gap1 without jumping and falls; death card 'Missed the landing' at t=5.02.
evidence.riff: The gap doesn't forgive and doesn't explain — 'Missed the landing' is the whole post-mortem.

evidence.observation: Player walks into the grumbler's side at x1617; death card 'Squashed by a grumbler', RETRIES 01.
evidence.riff: Side contact is the stomp's evil twin — same enemy, and vertical velocity decides which one you get.

features.reason: GDD MECH-05 defers moving platforms; not built.
Malware patrol with task undo; not built.
No checkpoints; retry always returns to spawn.
No double jump, wall jump, or dash; single jump only.
One level (First Steps, 1920px); no level select.
No lives or health; unlimited retries by design.
